style.name: Light French Country
style.definition: Weathered timber, gentle curves and washed colors interpreted with a light hand.
style.materials: limed oak; linen; cane; aged iron; faded blue cotton
style.living: ivory linen sofa with subtle curved arms; pale-blue cane-back armchair; oval limed-oak coffee table; limed-oak media cabinet; round pedestal oak dining table and four cane-back chairs; linen pendant
style.bed: limed-oak curved queen headboard; white linen with faded blue quilt; two oak nightstands and cream urn lamps
style.solarium: weathered teak and woven outdoor seating with faded-blue performance cushions; round teak dining set
style.implement: Use graceful furniture shapes to soften the black glazing, while keeping ornament restrained.
style.avoid: Avoid ornate chandeliers and faux distressed finishes everywhere.
